About.title: About me
About.p1: I'm Lorenzo, PMO at Aeonvis S.p.A. on the Credit Agricole Auto Bank account: I coordinate projects, people and deadlines where process meets technology. Before that, a UX/UI design thesis taught me to always start from real data and real people before designing a solution.
About.p2: Right now I'm shifting toward AI Product Engineering: studying and building tools that combine product thinking, design and development — this site included, built from scratch with Next.js and Supabase more as an ongoing training ground than a business card.
